infographic.title: A calm incident-response loop
infographic.description: A compact sequence for moving from an observed symptom to a verified recovery.

sources.title: Illustrative scenario authored for Infographic Studio

structure.title: Detect, decide, repair, learn
structure.description: Each stage hands evidence to the next one; the flow is intentionally linear.

items.title: Observe a signal
items.description: An alert, report or dashboard tells the team that behaviour changed.

items.title: Triage impact
items.description: Confirm the user impact, current scope and the fastest safe owner.

items.title: Apply a repair
items.description: Choose a reversible mitigation first, then make the durable change.

items.title: Verify recovery
items.description: Check the original symptom, the affected journey and the system signals.

items.title: Record the learning
items.description: Capture the decision, evidence and follow-up while the context is fresh.
